import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*np.cos(p[2]*t + p[3]) + p[4]*v + p[5]*v**2 + p[6]*v**3
            + p[7]*x + p[8]*x*v + p[9]*x*v**2 + 0*v*np.tanh(x))
